Special XXI (Palo Duro Canyon)
Inaugural Exhibition, 1997, Georgia O'Keeffe Museum (Santa Fe)

credit_line: Collection of the New Mexico Museum of Art. Gift of the Georgia O’Keeffe Estate, 1993 (1993.51.1)
description: A canyon runs between large, glowing yellow hills with blue ridges. A procession of circular forms lines the bottom of the canyon, winding through the landscape. Red and yellow clouds edged with blue float over the landscape.
